nodes.summary: The matrix determinant lemma in the `replicateCol` / `replicateRow` form stated in Mathlib's TODO for `Matrix.det_add_replicateCol_mul_replicateRow`. The `_general` suffix avoids clashing with Mathlib's invertible version of the same name.
nodes.title: Matrix determinant lemma in column-times-row form

nodes.summary: The matrix determinant lemma in multiplicative form, when `A.det` is a unit: this recovers Mathlib's `Matrix.det_add_replicateCol_mul_replicateRow` from the general version.
nodes.title: Multiplicative matrix determinant lemma for invertible matrices

nodes.summary: The matrix determinant lemma, without any invertibility hypothesis: the determinant of a rank-one update of `A` is `det A` plus the adjugate pairing `v ⬝ᵥ (adjugate A *ᵥ u)`. This is the general version left as a TODO in Mathlib's `Matrix.det_add_replicateCol_mul_replicateRow`.
nodes.title: Matrix determinant lemma without invertibility

nodes.summary: A rank-one update of `A` is a unit exactly when the adjugate correction term is a unit; no invertibility hypothesis on `A` is needed.
nodes.title: Invertibility criterion for a rank-one update

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
